Checking package.json for build scripts and verifying a search index comma bug.

Checking whether `safeJS` is incorrectly applied to JSON inside `application/json` script tags. `safeJS` escapes characters for JavaScript strings, but raw JSON in those tags needs plain `jsonify` or `| safe`. Escaping could break the JSON or cause `</script>` injection issues.

OAuth auth.js passes through the `state` parameter without generating or validating it. The callback route does not validate the `state` parameter either.

Search.js has two concrete issues. It attaches a keydown listener on every keystroke without removing previous listeners, causing memory leaks and duplicate handlers. It also duplicates matching logic between lines 157-180 and search-core, using regex for filtering while display uses includes, which creates inconsistent results.

URL search parameters are double-encoded at lines 82-84 because `urlParams.get("s")` is passed directly into `encodeURIComponent`.

`ensureHugo` uses `tar` for both `.tar.gz` and `.zip` extraction on Windows. This is fragile.

`clearModules.js` uses a non-global regex to remove `require()` blocks. It only strips the first match instead of all occurrences.

The clearModules.js regex is actually safe because go.mod typically contains only one require block. Still, unanchored replacement risks matching unrelated text.

script.html lines 47-52 declare both `defer` and `async` on the same script tag. Per the HTML specification, `async` overrides `defer`, so the `defer` attribute is effectively ignored.

themeGenerator.js parses hugo.toml with regex. This approach is fragile but functional.

noteFileDates.js relies on `birthtime`, which on Unix systems often returns `ctime` rather than true creation time.

In notes-graph.js, lines 1456-1460, `bootWhenReady` forces the global graph into present mode automatically. This is a significant UX and performance issue.

search-core.js line 3 calls `toLowerCase()` on `searchKeyword` without optional chaining. A null value would throw an error.

The `searchKeyword` null concern is invalid because tests enforce string fields. Now checking package.json and the `export-okf` reference in `deployBuildent`.

# Code Improvement Report

Scoped to `functions/`, `assets/js/`, `scripts/*.{mjs,js}`, and custom `layouts/` (excluding content, `.specstory`, vendor themes, archived scripts).

---

## P0 — High impact (fix first)

### 1. Search modal stacks keydown handlers on every keystroke
**Category:** Bug  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/search.js` **lines 184–234**

Inside `doSearch()`, every input adds a new `keydown` listener without removing the previous one:

```184:234:/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/search.js
    if (searchModal && searchString != "") {
      let resItems;
      resItems = searchResult[0].querySelectorAll(".search-result-item");
      // ...
      searchInput.forEach((el) => {
        el.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
      });
```

**Impact:** Arrow-key navigation and Enter-to-open degrade over time; memory grows; duplicate navigations after a few searches.

**Fix:** Register `handleKeyDown` once at init, or remove the old listener before adding (`{ once: false }` + named function + `removeEventListener`), or only attach when the modal opens.

---

### 2. Global graph auto-enters present/fullscreen mode on load
**Category:** Performance / UX bug  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/notes-graph.js` **lines 1450–1460**

```1456:1460:/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/notes-graph.js
    if (!isLocalGraph) {
      colors = readColors();
      syncCanvasSize();
      setPresentMode(true);
      return;
    }
```

**Impact:** `/notes/graph/` immediately reparents the graph to `document.body`, runs 360–520 layout iterations, starts PixiJS WebGL, and blocks normal page layout. Heavy on mobile and low-end devices.

**Fix:** Call `boot()` for global graphs too; only enter present mode when the user clicks expand (same as local graphs).

---

### 3. Graph build is O(n²) over all notes
**Category:** Performance  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/layouts/_partials/notes/graph-data.html` **lines 8–53**

Nested `range $from` × `range $to` with string scans per pair. At ~235 notes today that is ~55k inner iterations; at 500 notes it is ~250k, and Hugo rebuild cost grows fast.

**Fix:** Precompute a wikilink index once (title/slug/alias → page), then for each note scan only its `[[wikilinks]]` and look up targets in O(1). Or build edges in a single pass from `link-registry.html`.

---

### 4. Search UI duplicates match logic and diverges from `search-core.js`
**Category:** Bug / maintainability  
**Files:**
- `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/search.js` **lines 157–180** (regex filter for sections)
- `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/search.js` **lines 261–265** (rank/sort via `filterAndSortSearchResults`)
- `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/search-core.js` **lines 34–44**

The section filter at 157–180 always matches `description`, `tags`, and `categories` via regex, ignoring `searchOpts` (`data-description`, `data-tags`, `data-categories` from the wrapper). Display/ranking honors those toggles.

**Impact:** Results can appear in a section group but render empty, or rank differently than tests in `scripts/test-search.mjs` expect.

**Fix:** Replace the 157–180 block with `filterAndSortSearchResults` / `matchesSearch` from `search-core.js` (already imported).

---

## P1 — Security

### 5. OAuth callback broadcasts to `*` before origin is known
**Category:** Security  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/functions/api/callback.js` **lines 14–24**

```14:24:/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/functions/api/callback.js
      window.addEventListener("message", ({ data, origin }) => {
        if (data === "authorizing:${provider}") {
          window.opener?.postMessage(msg, origin);
          window.close();
        }
      });
      window.opener?.postMessage("authorizing:${provider}", "*");
```

Reply correctly uses `origin`, but the initial ping uses `"*"`.

**Fix:** Pass the expected CMS origin from env (e.g. `https://www.jorap.com`) and use that instead of `"*"`. Also validate `state` server-side if Sveltia expects it.

---

### 6. OAuth `scope` is passed through unchecked
**Category:** Security  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/functions/api/auth.js` **lines 26–33**

```26:33:/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/functions/api/auth.js
  const state = url.searchParams.get("state") || "";
  const scope = url.searchParams.get("scope") || "repo,user";
  // ...
  authUrl.searchParams.set("scope", scope);
```

**Fix:** Allowlist scopes (`repo`, `user`, maybe `read:user`) and reject anything else with 400.

---

### 7. Flashcard backs rendered with `safeHTML`
**Category:** Security (author-trust boundary)  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/layouts/_partials/notes/flashcard.html` **line 18**

```17:18:/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/layouts/_partials/notes/flashcard.html
      <span class="notes-flashcard__face notes-flashcard__face--front">{{ $front }}</span>
      <span class="notes-flashcard__face notes-flashcard__face--back">{{ $back | safeHTML }}</span>
```

Front is escaped; back is not. Card backs come from frontmatter/shortcodes (`cards-for-page.html`). A compromised CMS account or bad import could inject HTML/JS (mitigated somewhat by CSP, but `style-src 'unsafe-inline'` remains).

**Fix:** Treat backs like fronts (`htmlEscape` / plain text), or run through `RenderString` then sanitize. Review page already uses `.textContent` in JS (safe); inline flashcards on note pages are the exposure.

---

### 8. Duplicated admin CSP string
**Category:** Security / maintainability  
**Files:**
- `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/functions/admin/_middleware.js` **lines 5–6**
- `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/static/_headers` (admin block, ~lines 72–80 per comment)

**Fix:** Single source of truth (shared constant file imported by the Worker, or generate `_headers` from one template). Drift already caused a blank CMS once per the middleware comment.

---

## P2 — Performance

### 9. Force simulation is O(n²) per frame
**Category:** Performance  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/notes-graph.js` **lines 877–900**

Pairwise repulsion loop over all nodes every animation frame (capped at 240 nodes globally).

**Fix:** Spatial hash / Barnes–Hut, or stop simulation after `settleLayout()` and only re-sim on drag (radial mode already sets `simAlpha = 0`).

---

### 10. PixiJS pulls in `unsafe-eval`
**Category:** Security / performance  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/notes-graph.js` **line 4**

```4:6:/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/notes-graph.js
import "pixi.js/unsafe-eval";
import "pixi.js";
```

Needed for some Pixi paths but increases bundle size and weakens CSP posture if eval is ever required at runtime.

**Fix:** Confirm whether `unsafe-eval` is still required on Pixi v8 with WebGL-only; drop the import if the graph works without it.

---

### 11. `resolveToken()` probes DOM on every color read
**Category:** Performance  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/notes-graph.js` **lines 208–217, 1423–1425**

Creates/removes a `<span>` and calls `getComputedStyle` for each CSS variable. Called again on theme class mutation.

**Fix:** Cache resolved colors until theme observer fires; read tokens once at init.

---

### 12. Lazy script bundle uses both `defer` and `async`
**Category:** Performance / bug  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/layouts/_partials/essentials/script.html` **lines 47–52**

```47:52:/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/layouts/_partials/essentials/script.html
<script
  defer
  async
  crossorigin="anonymous"
```

Per HTML, `async` wins; `defer` is ignored. Load order becomes unpredictable.

**Fix:** Pick one. For lazy plugins, `defer` alone is usually right.

## P3 — Bugs (lower urgency)

### 13. `searchindex.json` can emit trailing commas
**Category:** Bug (latent)  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/layouts/_default/list.searchindex.json` **lines 19–61**

Comma logic uses last index of `$searchablePages`, not last *emitted* item. If trailing pages have `ignoreSearch: true`, JSON becomes `[{...},{...},]` — invalid.

**Fix:** Track `first` flag, or collect matching pages in a scratch slice then `jsonify` the slice.

---

### 14. URL search param double-encoding
**Category:** Bug  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/search.js` **lines 81–84**

`urlParams.get("s")` is decoded, then wrapped in `encodeURIComponent` again and later used as display value.

**Fix:** Use decoded value directly for `searchString`; only encode when writing history.

---

### 15. Windows Hugo install may mishandle `.zip`
**Category:** Bug  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/scripts/ensureHugo.mjs` **lines 107–108**

```107:108:/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/scripts/ensureHugo.mjs
  if (asset.endsWith(".tar.gz") || asset.endsWith(".zip")) {
    run("tar", ["-xf", archivePath, "-C", dir]);
```

`tar -xf` on `.zip` is environment-dependent.

**Fix:** Branch: `tar` for `.tar.gz`, `powershell Expand-Archive` or `unzip` for `.zip`.

---

### 16. `touch-controls.js` always `preventDefault` on `touchend`
**Category:** Bug (mobile UX)  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/assets/js/touch-controls.js` **lines 17–23**

Can suppress native click synthesis and interfere with scrolling on controls that are not simple buttons.

**Fix:** Only `preventDefault` when the touch did not move beyond a slop threshold, or rely on `click` alone where 300 ms duplicate-guard is enough.

## P4 — Maintainability / over-engineering

### 17. `clearModules.js` strips `go.mod` via regex
**Category:** Over-engineering / reproducibility risk  
**File:** `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/scripts/clearModules.js` **lines 3–14**

Used by `pnpm run update-modules` (not production build). Regex deletion of `require (...)` is fragile and works against pinned, reproducible module graphs.

**Fix:** Replace with `hugo mod tidy` only, or delete the script if vendoring makes it unnecessary.

---

### 18. `safeJS` on `type="application/json"` embeds
**Category:** Maintainability  
**Files (same pattern):**
- `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/layouts/notes/graph.html` **line 40**
- `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/layouts/notes/review.html` **line 100**
- `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/layouts/_partials/notes/preview-index.html` **line 9**
- `/Users/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/layouts/_partials/notes/random-unrelated-notes.html` **line 61**
- others using `jsonify | safeJS`

`safeJS` targets JS string contexts, not raw JSON. `jsonify` already escapes `</script>`.

**Fix:** Use `{{ $data | jsonify }}` inside `<script type="application/json">` consistently.
